== Procedure ==
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven Temperatures|350°F (175°C)]]. 
# Lightly grease an 8 x 4-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (20 x 10 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) [[cookbook:loaf pan|loaf pan]].
# Combine all ingredients into a large [[cookbook:mixing bowl|mixing bowl]]. Beat well.
# Pour batter into pan.
# [[cookbook:Bake|Bake]] on middle shelf of oven for 60 minutes, or until a [[Cookbook:Toothpick|toothpick]] inserted into the center of the loaf comes out clean.  

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]] and ⅓ cup milk can be substituted for the sour milk/buttermilk and baking soda.
* ½ cup nuts may also be added to the mixture

{{Recipe}}

'''Banana bread''' is a type of quick-bread or [[Cookbook:Cake|cake]]. This recipe yields a dense and moist banana bread, studded with walnuts.

== Ingredients ==
* 490 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
* 5½+⅛ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], softened
* 320 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Turbinado Sugar|turbinado sugar]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (200 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* 950 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] mashed [[Cookbook:Banana|banana]]
* 2 ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Walnut|walnuts]], coarsely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* [[Cookbook:Turbinado Sugar|Turbinado sugar]] for sprinkling

== Procedure ==

# Combine the flour, baking powder, and salt.
# [[Cookbook:Cream|Cream]] the butter and sugar together until light and fluffy.
# Whisk the eggs, and gradually beat them into the butter mixture.
# Mix in one third of the flour mixture, followed by half the banana. Continue alternating in this way until all the dry mixture and mashed banana is incorporated.
# Stir in the walnuts.
# Grease and line 2 [[Cookbook:Loaf Pan|loaf pans]]. Divide batter evenly between pans. Sprinkle the tops with additional turbinado sugar.
# [[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] at 350°F for at least 1 hour. After this point, check the banana bread every 10 minutes or so until it is done. It will be browned, and a [[Cookbook:Skewer|skewer]] inserted into the center of the loaf should come out clean with no more than moist crumbs attached.
# Let cool to room temperature in the pans. Unmold.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* The quantity of walnuts may be increased or decreased as desired.
* Slices of this banana bread can be toasted, although they are somewhat fragile.

{{Recipe}}

This easy '''banana bread''' recipe only requires a few ingredients. If you want to make the tastiest banana bread, make sure to use overripe bananas.

== Procedures ==

* 3–4 overripe [[Cookbook:Banana|bananas]], peeled
* ½–1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|baking soda]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], melted
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* 2 cups [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|Vegetable oil]]

== Special equipment ==

* [[Cookbook:Oven|Oven]]
* Masher
* [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|Cake]] or [[Cookbook:Loaf Pan|loaf pan]]

== Procedure ==

# Mash the bananas into a smooth paste. When working with a significant quantity of bananas, mash them with a fork or a potato masher.
# Stir in the sugar, baking soda, egg, and butter.
# If desired to balance the sweetness or flavor, stir in a [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of salt. 
# Combine the flour and cinnamon. Add this mixture in a slow, steady stream, stirring constantly until smooth and lump-free. Do not over-mix, or it will become tough.
# Transfer the batter to a greased baking pan. Tap the pan on the table after pouring the batter to assist remove air bubbles and set the batter in the baking pan, making it easier to remove after baking.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at at 350°F (180 C) until it turns golden brown and a [[Cookbook:Skewer|skewer]] inserted into the center comes out clean.
# Allow your bread to cool somewhat before removing it from the baking pan. This will prevent your bread from breaking apart as you remove it.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* You can use [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]] or [[Cookbook:Peanut Butter|peanut butter]] in place of butter for a nutritious vegan banana bread.
* Any type of flour (e.g. oat flour) can be used in this banana bread recipe, but the texture will vary depending on the type of flour you choose.
